device_entry.name: 树莓派相机
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
device_entry.description: 一款通过 REST API 控制的树莓派相机，用于实验中的图像采集、单张拍照、预览图获取和实时观察，并可设置 ISO 与曝光时间等成像参数。
device_entry.description_en: A Raspberry Pi camera controlled through a REST API, used in laboratory setups for image acquisition, snapshot capture, preview retrieval, and live viewing, with configurable imaging parameters such as ISO and exposure time.
